_note: v1.1.0 Features settings (single source). Engine: which state each feature parks when it is off (paths) and which unlock it gates. UI: rows of Student file > Settings > Features. tools/gen_mvu_entries.py measures each feature's rule text (EJS gates on(id) in 502/504/505) and writes data/feature_cost.json. control: toggle = on/off in $ui.off; levels = its own field in $ui (level 'off' counts as off).

features.name: Proficiency and practice
features.desc: Six abilities grow through classes, daily life and practice; ranks add to Fortune in their field.

features.name: Planner
features.desc: Commitments: promises, appointments and deadlines with due times and overdue reminders.

features.name: Notice Board notices
features.desc: Story notices pinned on the board (paid work, recruitment, warnings). Official postings always show.

features.name: Letters
features.desc: Mail Tower letters in and out, with waiting reminders.

features.name: Mystery Board
features.desc: Clues and mystery threads you piece together.

features.name: Competition
features.desc: Your standing in the Dorm, Academy, Kingdom and World Competitions.

features.name: Projects
features.desc: Brewing, crafting, research and group work that takes more than one sitting.

features.name: Trips
features.desc: Crowning Day and the Academy Trip: who you travel with, where you are.

features.name: Battle tracking
features.desc: Opponents' health, stamina and status during a fight.

features.name: Bag (inventory)
features.desc: Things you buy, receive or find and keep; weather gear counts from here.

features.name: Campus happenings
features.desc: A small seeded happening on some days: paid work, a Dove sweep, a loose creature.

features.name: NPC initiative
features.desc: NPCs with Rank 3+ bonds may seek you out on some seeded days, in a way that fits their character. Never moves a scene for you.

features.name: Weather
features.desc: Seasons, sky and °C per morning, afternoon and night; the Divination Society forecast. Full adds real effects: conditions, gear, sleep, bonds, who is outdoors.

features.name: Class-aware presence
features.desc: During lessons students are in class: the narrator knows your class, teacher and classmates.

features.name: Story hooks
features.desc: The narrator's private notes on promises and planted details it owes a payoff. Never shown to you.

features.name: Gossip that spreads
features.desc: Rumours reach more people day by day, then fade or die out.

features.name: Fortune roll
features.desc: A d100 the engine rolls for each reply, the same on every swipe. The narrator uses it only for an important, genuinely uncertain attempt of yours, with modifiers for your state and the situation (fitting magic helps a lot).

features.name: Attendance
features.desc: The engine notices when you skip a class (Academy -2, the teacher reacts), rewards a clean week (Academy +2) and Saturday club time (Student +1). Excused: Medical Centre, a head cold, injuries, trips, battles.

features.name: Weekly recap
features.desc: A one-line Journal recap when a week ends: ranks reached, reputation changes, skipped classes, big point changes.

features.name: Small scenes on ordinary days
features.desc: On a day with nothing on the calendar, no more than four people are with you at once; one more takes their leave. Classes, clubs, parties and battles are exempt.

features.name: Ambience
features.desc: How crowded and how lit a place is (the sun follows the seasons), and one sensory cue when you arrive or the hour changes. Full adds small things happening around you now and then, and, very rarely, a moment from one of Halvard's ghost stories.

features.name: Report reminders
features.desc: When the last reply seems to have left something out of its update (an injury without a name, an item that left the Bag, a spell that was not charged, a conversation not counted, time that did not move), the narrator is reminded once. Reminders never change anything by themselves.

features.name: Study and exams
features.desc: Time in the Library, Study Rooms and Archive, study sessions with friends and Saturday Study Hall prepare you for exams. The engine marks every subject A–F from your preparation, the proficiency the subject draws on, your attendance of its classes, how the exam day goes and your condition on it; the marks set your reputation and, on the Results days, your dorm rank (and so your payout). An A pays for tutoring and helps Fortune rolls in its field, an A or B warms its teacher to you, an F brings a remedial session.
